_comment: ALFA Golden Evaluation Dataset — ground-truth expected values for automated benchmarking.
_instructions: Each entry represents one company annual report evaluation case.
Fields with 'expected_*' keys are ground-truth values verified against the actual Annual Report.
Run scripts/run_eval.py to compare ALFA extractions against these values.
To add a new case: add an entry to the 'cases' array, populate 'expected_fields' with
verified values from the annual report, and set 'pdf_path' to the relative PDF path.
Amounts are always in Indian Rupees Lakhs (₹L) unless otherwise noted.
